name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenb
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Simulate time evolution of the 3-site Heisenberg XXZ chain (Jx=Jy=1, Jz=0.85, open boundary) for time t=1.62 in Qiskit using first-order Trotterization with 60 steps. Start from the Neel state and compare <Z_0>(t) against exact evolution with scipy.linalg.expm. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
